name: linear_list_workflow_states
description: List the workflow states (statuses) for a team: { id, name, type }. `type` is one of backlog, unstarted, started, completed, canceled. You need a state's `id` to move an issue with linear_update_issue (pass it as stateId). Provide `teamId` (from linear_list_teams).

teamId.description: The team id (from linear_list_teams) whose states to list.

body_defaults.query: query TeamStates($teamId: ID!) { workflowStates(filter: { team: { id: { eq: $teamId } } }) { nodes { id name type } } }
